svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drawn upside down: stand the box on its top, back face toward you;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the top view then shows the bottom face as you see it on the bench.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure from the back face, and sideways from the centre line (left and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: right as seen from the front). The drilling layout picture repeats this.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back row, 27 mm from the back face: gland 1 at 40 left, gland 2 at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 8 left (16.2 mm holes), vent at 24 right (12.2 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front row, 55 mm from the back face: port A at 54 left, port B at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 22 left (16.2 mm), antenna at 30 right (6.5 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every outside flange is at least 8 mm from the next one.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tape the face, pilot drill 3 mm slowly with wood behind, open out with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a step drill, light pressure. No solvents: polycarbonate crazes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr inside and out. Check each hole size on the part's datasheet

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: before the last step of the drill.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit the lugs (the maker's kit) to the four back corners as the maker says.
